privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How the contact form on Miguel Angel Giraldo Duque’s site handles personal data.
privacy.intro: This page explains which data the contact form on this site asks for and what it is used for. It is a draft written for a commercial inquiry in Argentina, under Personal Data Protection Law 25,326 and regulatory decree 1558/2001. It is not a lawyer’s advice.
privacy.responsibleBefore: Miguel Angel Giraldo Duque, independent developer, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. The site is
privacy.rightsRequest: To ask for access, correction, an update, or deletion, use the contact form on this site and say which right you want to exercise.
privacy.dataIntro: The form may keep this data, which you provide voluntarily:
privacy.dataSensitive: The form does not ask for sensitive data under section 2 of Law 25,326 (for example health, political opinions, or beliefs). If you put that in the message, it is not needed: a name, an email, and the project are enough to reply.
privacy.dataHoneypot: There is a hidden field people do not fill in. It filters automated submissions. If it contains text, the message is discarded.
privacy.purpose: The only purpose is to answer your inquiry and, if it applies, prepare a quote for a landing page or other work you ask for. I do not sell this data and I do not use it for third-party advertising.
privacy.consent: The basis is your consent, which you give by checking the box on the form. Without that consent the message is not sent. If you do not want to leave this data, you can write to me on LinkedIn, linked from the home page.
privacy.retention: It is kept for as long as needed to reply and follow up on that inquiry, with a suggested limit of 24 months from the last message, unless you ask for deletion sooner or a rule requires keeping it longer.
privacy.logs: This version of the site has no database of its own. The message is prepared to be sent by email. Until that sending is connected to a provider, the server may keep a copy in its technical logs so the inquiry can be seen during development. When the provider is chosen, this sentence has to be updated.
privacy.hosting: The site is hosted by a hosting provider (planned: Vercel). That provider processes the technical request of the form.
privacy.transfer: Email does not go out to a specific provider yet. When it is connected, the message will pass through that service (for example Resend, in the United States, or an SMTP service such as a personal mailbox). That can be an international transfer. Section 12 of Law 25,326 requires the country or the recipient to offer an adequate level of protection, or another valid basis. The provider and the basis will be filled in on this page before sending is turned on.
privacy.rights: You can ask for access to your data (section 14) and for it to be corrected, updated, or deleted (section 16). You can also withdraw consent for future uses. Deletion does not erase messages that were already needed to answer an inquiry in progress, but it stops new uses.
privacy.authorityBefore: The supervisory authority is the Agency for Access to Public Information (AAIP), National Directorate for Personal Data Protection:
privacy.security: I use reasonable measures so the form is not left open to automated submissions and so this data is not published on the site. No transmission over the internet is impossible to intercept.
privacy.minors: The site and the form are not directed at minors.
privacy.changes: If this policy changes, the new version is published at this same address with a new date.
